newsitem.title: UK: UK industry can cope with current stg rate-Lang.
newsitem.headline: UK industry can cope with current stg rate-Lang.

text.p: British industry can cope with the current strong rate of sterling, Trade and Industry Secretary Ian Lang told parliament on Wednesday.
"The present exchange rate is a reflection of the strength and growth of the British economy.

"It helps to fight inflation, and I believe that the improved productivity and competitiveness of our economy enables us to continue to manufacture and export at present levels," Lang said at question time.
He added that the capacity of governments to influence exchange rates was "extremely limited".
